# British Heart Foundation

> > The UK's leading independent funder of heart and circulatory research, providing research grants, patient support, CPR training, and health information to save lives from cardiovascular disease.

The British Heart Foundation (BHF) is a major UK charity dedicated to funding cardiovascular research and providing comprehensive support to patients, carers, and the public. The site combines research funding opportunities, clinical health information, emergency response training, and community engagement resources.

## Key Topics

- CPR training
- Cardiovascular research
- Heart conditions
- Defibrillators
- Cardiac arrest
- Emergency response
- Patient support
- Fundraising
- Volunteering
- Heart health prevention
- Diagnostic tests
- Treatments and medications
- Workplace wellness
- First aid
- RevivR platform

## About BHF

- [The biggest independent funder of heart and circulatory research in the UK - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk): BHF homepage: UK's leading independent funder of heart research
- [Who we are - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/what-we-do/who-we-are): BHF mission and history since 1961 funding cardiovascular research
- [Information for professionals - British Heart Foundation - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/for-professionals): Research grants, healthcare resources, and press information

## Heart Health Information & Support

- [Heart health questions, information and support - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/informationsupport): Central hub for heart health information and patient support
- [Risk factors for heart and circulatory diseases | BHF - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/informationsupport/risk-factors): Information on cardiovascular risk factors and prevention
- [Tests for heart conditions - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/informationsupport/tests): Guide to cardiac diagnostic tests: ECG, angiogram, MRI
- [Treatments for heart and circulatory conditions - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/informationsupport/treatments): Expert-backed guide to heart treatments and medications
- [Support - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/informationsupport/support): Emotional and practical support for cardiac patients and carers
- [Heart Matters Magazine - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/informationsupport/heart-matters-magazine): Magazine for cardiac patients with lifestyle advice and recipes

## CPR & Emergency Response Training

- [CPR and defibrillators: how to save a life  - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/how-you-can-help/how-to-save-a-life): CPR and defibrillator training for workplace and community
- [Learn how to do CPR | British Heart Foundation - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/how-you-can-help/how-to-do-cpr): Five-step guide to CPR and hands-only CPR techniques
- [Learn CPR in 15 minutes for free | RevivR  - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/how-you-can-help/how-to-save-a-life/learn-cpr): Free 15-minute online CPR training with RevivR platform

## Get Involved & Support BHF

- [How you can help beat heartbreak forever - British Heart Foundation  - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/how-you-can-help): Central hub for donation, fundraising, volunteering, and support
- [Volunteer with British Heart Foundation - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/how-you-can-help/volunteer): Volunteer opportunities in BHF shops, events, and fundraising
- [Leave a gift in your Will - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/how-you-can-help/leave-a-gift-in-your-will): Guide to legacy giving and will writing for BHF support

## Community & Local Resources

- [Find the British Heart Foundation near you - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/what-we-do/find-bhf-near-you): Locate BHF branches, shops, heart clubs and CPR training centres
- [Health at work – workplace wellbeing with BHF - BHF](https://www.bhf.org.uk/how-you-can-help/health-at-work): Workplace wellness programme with CPR and health checks
